newsitem.title: USA: Unisource sees FY97 annualized revs $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: Unisource sees FY97 annualized revs $500 mln.

text.p: Unisource Worldwide Inc Thursday said it expects to meet its fiscal year 1997 goal of $500 million in annualized revenues.
The paper products marketer and distributor also said it sees average paper prices stabilizing at or near current levels, resulting in improved earnings through the year.
Ray Mundt, chairman and chief executive of Unisource, said, "We expect to reach our goal of $500 million in annualized revenues for fiscal 1997."

"Average paper prices for the first quarter of our fiscal year were approximately 17 percent lower than the same quarter last year, however, we expect prices to stabilize at or near current levels, which should result in improved quarter-over-quarter comparisons as we proceed through the year."
